brief_schema: active-observation-brief-v2; legacy results without patch support retain v1
legacy_frame_compatibility: Three-buffer input may derive ownership only where every ROI object is one supported patch covering all its source faces. Multi-patch/partial objects require real patch ownership.
mapping_identity: Bound to complete actual ordered source vertices/faces, face-to-patch mapping and ROI order. Source-order changes invalidate accepted image state and stale receipts before view selection.
optimized_kernel_comparison: Fixed five alternating pairs on first split SCENE saved buffer, independent shared boundary+perROI masks vs shared histogram. No extra raster or warmup.
partial_scope: Every source triangle assigned once to a supported region or an unknown component. Full retains indices, brief carries per-object totals/status and component ranges/reasons. Geometric support is distinct from observed coverage.
patch_owner: int32 stable ordinal in sorted ROI IDs. -1 means background or unsupported winning triangle; original object owner separates those.
pre_registered_answers: 138 patches and3336 supported/1unsupported triangles from independent axis constructor, SCENE visible upper face and front-facing fully hidden rear with positive237/2048m gap; bottom faces back-facing for all six directions.
product_scope: Maximal edge-connected exactly coplanar rectangle patches with exact winding/area/boundary proof. Unsupported components retain source triangle membership and participate in occlusion.

readability.boundary: Unique4-neighbor pixel endpoints with changed patch ID and Euclidean RGB squared distance>=576.

registered_fixture: Same ordered world vertices/triangles as old scaled full scene, plus one preregistered unsupported triangle, split29 and joined1 source representations.
same_depth_update: Object and patch owner updated by the original strict nearer mask alongside RGB/depth. Equal-depth retains original drawing order.
